svg.title: Meet the cast
svg.desc: Pixel-art cast line-up at night: Sammy the opossum with a bloody chainsaw (coming next), a rotting zombie jogger in a torn tracksuit and sweatband, a zombie hot dog vendor in a bloody apron who lobs hot dogs from afar, the chainsaw (coming next, cuts them in half), the hot dog cart (two whips tip it, 3 healing hot dogs), and the trash lid shield (blocks 3 hits).
